description: TPS61040 60V (switch) boost converter, adjustable output, PFM control, low IQ

pinout.name: SW
pinout.notes: Connect the inductor and Schottky diode to this pin. Switch pin, connected to drain of internal power MOSFET.

pinout.name: FB
pinout.notes: Feedback pin; connect to external voltage divider to program the output voltage.

pinout.name: EN
pinout.notes: Enable pin. Pulling to ground forces shutdown (<1uA supply current). Must not be left floating; needs to be terminated.

decoupling.placement: as close as possible to the input pin
decoupling.notes: Recommended operating condition value; needed for good input voltage filtering.

decoupling.placement: as close as possible to the SW pin
decoupling.notes: Placed close to SW to minimize noise coupling into other circuits.

decoupling.placement: output capacitor per recommended operating conditions

land_pattern.notes: From TI DBV0005A example board layout, 4214839/K 08/2024. Body outline approx 2.6mm x 1.9mm (per package outline drawing, mold body 3.0/2.6 x 1.75/1.45mm range).

layout_notes: The input capacitor must be placed as close as possible to the input (VIN) pin for good input voltage filtering.
The inductor and diode must be placed as close as possible to the SW pin to minimize noise coupling into other circuits.
The feedback (FB) pin and network is high-impedance; route it away from the inductor and shield with a ground plane or trace to minimize noise coupling.
Use wide traces for the bolded high-current connections (VIN, SW loop, GND) per the datasheet's layout diagram (Figure 7-12).
Use a star ground connection or ground plane to minimize ground shifts and noise.
